issue_context.title: `test_bond_operstate` from systemd-networkd-tests.py is flaky
issue_context.body:
In past several runs I noticed fails in `test_bond_operstate`:

```
======================================================================
FAIL: test_bond_operstate (__main__.NetworkdNetWorkBondTests)
----------------------------------------------------------------------
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "./test/test-network/systemd-networkd-tests.py", line 1573, in test_bond_operstate
    self.assertRegex(output, 'State: no-carrier \(configured\)')
AssertionError: Regex didn't match: 'State: no-carrier \\(configured\\)' not found in '● 104: bond99\n       Link File: /usr/lib/systemd/network/99-default.link\n    Network File: /run/systemd/network/bond99.network\n            Type: bond\n           State: degraded-carrier (configured)\n          Driver: bonding\n      HW Address: 3e:34:da:ee:33:a4\n         Address: 192.168.123.45\n                  fe80::3c34:daff:feee:33a4'
```

Full log: https://ci.centos.org/job/systemd-pr-build/lastFailedBuild/artifact/systemd-centos-ci/artifacts_t2Zcvj/testsuite-logs-upstream.BXq/systemd-networkd-tests.py_FAIL.log

https://ci.centos.org/job/systemd-pr-build/5796/ (PR #12341)
https://ci.centos.org/job/systemd-pr-build/5783/ (PR #12334)
